summary: Workflow has proper permissions, triggers, and action pinning. However, missing Set-StrictMode in PowerShell scripts (best practice for safety). Anti-pattern: integration tests spawn redundant pwsh processes (& pwsh -NoProfile -File from within shell: pwsh) instead of invoking directly. Severe duplication: lines 40–95 contain five nearly identical integration test cases with identical setup/execute/verify patterns—should be refactored into a parameterized test helper to comply with DRY. Adding a new test case requires duplicating entire step. Regex patterns in Get-VersionBumpType lack explanatory comments. Module code itself is sound but test structure is unmaintainable.
